question: Across all orders, which region brought in the highest sales (unit price x quantity)?

sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'returned' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY revenue DESC
SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'products' ORDER BY ordinal_position

SELECT c.region, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS sales
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY sales DESC

answer: The south region generated the most revenue: 1,201,250.00, summed as product price × quantity over all order items. This includes all order statuses, as the question didn't ask for any filter. South also leads if returned orders are excluded (its revenue stays at 1,201,250.00 and west is next at 1,173,750.00).

question: Rank the customer regions by revenue (price times quantity) and tell me which one is first.

answer: The top region is South, with total revenue of 1,201,250.00 (sum of price × quantity over all order items, joined through orders to customers' region). The next regions are West (1,173,750), North (1,162,500), and East (1,160,000). This includes all order statuses (placed, shipped, delivered, returned), since the question didn't ask for a filter.
